question: Can an archived intervention-conditioned causal rule be retrieved without phase labels after interference and improve causal choices on never-trained feature vectors beyond equally informed independent Bayesian changepoint and source/recent controls?
hypothesis: A source-preserving evidence-routed causal-rule archive will recover earlier A-specific intervention responses when the environment returns to A; unique cumulative gain requires outperforming a Bayesian-hazard model with equal input/action exposure, not merely the frozen source or memorized addresses.

worlds.observed_consequence: binary reward after an actual chosen action
worlds.latent_rule: one pair of 8 sensed binary parent features combined by XOR with hidden bias defines preferred action; opposite action lower reward; 10% public outcome noise
worlds.experience: A96 public interventions/feedback events; B64; R64; externally generated balanced but world-independent action policy. Source model frozen after A, no B/R labels or hidden parent pair to learner; all arms receive exactly the same interventions and consequences.
worlds.holdout: At B64 and R64 endpoints evaluate 32 previously unseen full 8-bit contexts per seed (not in A/B/R exposures or other held probes); choose an action before outcome observed; held outcomes are domain separated and never used to update source/active models.
worlds.context: Each new physical sensor vector is an 8-bit state, unlike Gate26's fixed 16 addresses. Source and B worlds use independently chosen disjoint pairs of relevant sensor parents, bias; R repeats A rule with fresh never-seen features. No task-ID, phase labels, true causal graph, oracle reward or data-dependent split allowed.

mechanism.family: tokenless intervention-conditioned Bayesian causal signatures; 56 hypotheses = 28 parent pairs ×2 XOR biases; fixed capacity
mechanism.source_rule: independently fit posterior over 56 causal hypotheses from A96 public action+consequence; freeze posterior bytes after A
mechanism.active_rule: fit identical posterior over recent last32 B/R public events; no global phase label
mechanism.archive_router: prequential evidence FIFO of last16 signed log likelihood ratio outcomes for source A versus recent rule. Before 8 post-A events use A. After 8, sigmoid(clip(sum signed evidence,-12,+12)) weights preserved source against active recent; update evidence after prediction and actual feedback only. Exact quantitative soft rule frozen in source before first result.
mechanism.no_source_ablation: same router and recent posterior, with archived source removed (predicts .5 until last8 recent observations)
controls: independent 56-hypothesis full Bayesian changepoint posterior with fixed per-event hazard 1/64 and uniform reset
independent conventional Bayesian source/recency mixture with hazard 1/64 and source archive
negative_controls: public outcome noise independent of action/sensors
mechanism.compute: All receive same A96 B64 R64 actual observed interventions and held feature splits; count candidate hypothesis posterior operations, acknowledge unequal compute; no FLOP or energy-matched claim.
mechanism.capacity: Compact deterministic JSON checkpoint <=20000 bytes (including SHA256 integrity wrapper), fixed 56-rule universe and at most 32 active recent events, 16 evidence values, 56-vector Bayesian hazard. No extra model weights or remote services.
mechanism.cold: Three independently started Python child processes per seed: A fit + serialize, B restore/update + serialize, R restore/update + readout. Verify same-process warm replay snapshot and held decisions. Temporary private checkpoint files, no repo model mutation or owner runner.

metrics.primary: Matched related 32 paired seeds: B online prequential Brier over 64 action outcomes, R online prequential Brier over 64, R held action reward over 32 never-trained physical 8-bit contexts. Report paired 95% normal CIs and full per-cohort metrics.
metrics.secondary: R held action-choice accuracy over 32 new contexts vs hidden best action (evaluator only), source functional restoration after two actual child-process exits, checkpoint SHA and byte preservation, stationary false activation, noise regression vs chance, compute/rule evaluations.

classification_rules.engineering: Full identical-head Linux/Windows repo unittest, atlas, source replay and science audit pass
classification_rules.scientific_supported: All 18 primary thresholds PASS, then only preliminary synthetic contribution; separate owner/native independently reproduced first-use required
classification_rules.scientific_negative: Any criterion fails, preserve quantitative negatives and any bounded component passes; no promotion
classification_rules.invalid: Primary score precedes committed frozen source/protocol, action/data inequality, held leak, true phase/oracle cue, after-score retune, or missing exact-source custody.

limitations: Standalone contributor prototype, not a change to native PublicCausalCells, canonical memory, or accepted Yggdrasil architecture. Process-exit evidence is host-local, not host-reboot/cross-host. Protocol's XOR family may be simple for Bayesian controls; zero data/matched info matters more than favorable results.
